questions.stem_text:
Baxter argues that we should view our treatment of the environment as a matter of various
trade-offs whose aim is

options.A: to minimize damage incurred by all individual living beings.
options.B: to promote the functional integrity of ecosystems.
options.C: to minimize the suffering of all sentient creatures.
options.D: to ensure the survival of endangered species.
options.E: to minimize damage to the ozone layer.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - to minimize damage incurred by all individual living beings.

questions.stem_text: In the context of Gardiner's article, "the fragmentation of agency" refers to what?

options.A: an agent's inability to acknowledge his or her contribution to climate change
options.B: the fragmentation of the effects of greenhouse gas emissions across generations
options.C: the vast number of individuals and agents who contribute to climate change
options.D: the idea that it's not rational for each individual to restrict his or her own pollution

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - the vast number of individuals and agents who contribute to climate change
